outcome: ultrasound provision for reduced fetal movements
proportion of primiparous women presenting with RFM
cohort: The study included women presenting with a first episode of reduced fetal movements during comparative pre-COVID (March-April 2019) and COVID (March-April 2020) periods.
finding: The COVID-19 pandemic was associated with a significant decrease in first attendances for reduced fetal movements, with primiparous women being over-represented, but it did not impact the stillbirth rate or ultrasound provision.
